about: Sixfold's custom instructions (opcode custom-0). Edit this file or design them in web/custom.html, then run `make custom` to regenerate src/Custom_Unit.sv and the model, and `make test` to check the RTL against the model. Language: model/custom.js. Guide: docs/CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md.

instructions.name: absdiff
instructions.expr: a > b ? a - b : b - a
instructions.desc: Absolute difference (unsigned): the core of motion search in video encoders (sum of absolute differences)

instructions.name: avgu
instructions.desc: Average of two unsigned numbers, rounded down, that cannot overflow (the shared bits plus half the different ones)

instructions.name: hamming
instructions.desc: Hamming distance: how many bits differ (error-correcting codes, comparing fingerprints)

instructions.name: clampi
instructions.desc: Clamp a signed number to 0 ... imm (saturate a pixel to 0 ... 255 in one instruction)
